story: A nine-rider breakaway set the early pace, while Paul Seixas dropped from the peloton and later abandoned following injuries sustained in yesterday's crash. On the final climb, UAE Team Emirates-XRG imposed a fierce tempo before Isaac del Toro attacked with 8 kilometres remaining, taking both the stage victory and the general classification.
